scope: Private synchronous same-volume paired-link custody, not a worker-task ACK or persistent Model publication
evidence_policy: Fresh exact candidate checks and actual separate-invocation review govern component completion. This descriptive report supplies no executed or parent pass.
controls: A trusted host-captured empty canonical receiver root, ancestors, task/nonce and separate host/ACK-observation callbacks precede effects. No decoded caller object or returned receipt supplies that authority.
One nonqueueing source handoff reservation is installed before callbacks/metadata. A distinct one-use ACK reservation prevents competing observations/unlinks.

Atomic exclusive same-volume links publish the exact closed files without copy or replacement. Recorded same-inode pairs prove single-to-double-to-single link transitions while size/mtime/hash stay fixed and legitimate ctime transitions are captured.

The complete manifest and minimized bound receipt precede any trusted receiver observation. Receipt/root/authority mutations and nonboolean/async acknowledgements deny. Identity witnesses use lossless decimal strings, without claiming a Node protocol.

Fresh complete bytes/identities after the observer precede known source-name unlink. Host-owned cleanup is separate from expired source egress. Unknown or partial syscalls retain remaining source/recipient names and the lease, never retry or delete the receiver.
controlled_observations: Twenty-eight focused handoff cases pass with real disposable same-volume files and controlled effect/ACK failures. The existing eighteen staging cases remain compatible.

Positive receipt/ACK preserves exact bytes and inode identity, proves link-count transitions and removes only the owned original skeleton. A returned receipt without receiver observation retains custody.
Occupied targets, controlled EXDEV, mid-manifest failure and effect-then-thrown link/unlink acknowledgement cannot overwrite, copy, retry or remove receiver data.
Changed shared bytes, a third link, foreign source/receiver files, renamed parents, closed context, uncaptured authority, receipt mutation and observer retirement deny.

Held constructor and ACK callbacks with competing callers prove one inventory/observation and no competing creation or unlink. A held ACK retains custody past source egress expiry, then permits only positively owned cleanup.

Closing the source context during the final precreation callback retains original bytes and lease until actual preparation settlement; the resumed constructor cannot create recipient data after its scope has ended.
retained_corrections: Independent preflight found constructor ownership was installed after callbacks and source verification, allowing two attempts to enter recipient effects. A per-source nonqueueing reservation now precedes all callbacks/metadata; the causal competing-recipient case proves the correction.

ACK has its own one-use reservation and competing-observer regression. Receipt field snapshots and source context lifetime are rechecked after callbacks; preparation settlement prevents early lease credit. Identity witness numbers are consistently lossless.
qualification_limits: These are ordinary same-volume disposable-file OS calls and controlled failures. EXDEV is injected; physical cross-volume/native platform qualification is not claimed.

Receiver files remain temporary and read-only under their owning host lifecycle. Link presence, a receipt and local ACK grant no persistent Model reference, import/registration, runtime readiness or quality.
Hardlinks share mutable bytes. Cooperative guards do not prove hostile native immutability, directory-fsync/crash/restart durability or a hard deadline for uninterruptible IO/observation.

Future worker-task ACK, captured Node ownership, resource/import/registration and public plan wiring remain I7 work. The worker cannot release sender custody merely because it serialized this receipt.

No new provider, engine, credentials, scheduler, process or holding map is added. Ordinary SDK downloads and accepted model accuracy are unchanged; no external/model/host/public/parent/chunk pass is claimed.
